acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr diff <pr-number> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke  (and legion gh -- pr view <pr-number> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json files to confirm exactly one file, additions=1, deletions=0)
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: PR diff shows README.md as the only changed file, one line added, zero removed, and that added line reads exactly 'Stage 3 smoke: Legion workflow proof'.
acceptanceCriteria.owner: implementer proves at PR open; tester re-verifies; reviewer confirms on GitHub
acceptanceCriteria.surface: GitHub pull request on sjawhar/legion-smoke (production-like: the real PR the implementer opens).

acceptanceCriteria.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git fetch && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" file show -r main@origin README.md | tail -n 1   (spec-equivalent of `git show main:README.md`); expect final line 'Stage 3 smoke: Legion workflow proof'
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: After merge, README.md on main ends with the exact marker line.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: main branch of sjawhar/legion-smoke after merge (production surface).

nonGoals: No new files (e.g. smoke/stage3.txt) — rejected in spec.
No edit to any file other than README.md.
No change to existing README.md lines.
ordering: 1. cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" status; confirm on empty working copy over main.

2. Confirm README.md exists and marker absent (already verified: exists, marker absent). Error-branch handling per spec: if README.md were missing, create it with only the marker and note creation in the PR; if marker already present, make no change and report in the PR. Neither branch applies here.
3. Append exactly one line 'Stage 3 smoke: Legion workflow proof' as the new final line of README.md, preserving all existing content and a single trailing newline. No other edit.
4. jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --stat to confirm 1 file, 1 insertion, 0 deletions; jj describe the implementation commit.
5. Set bookmark legion/S393183870-1 and push; open PR with body containing 'Dispatch: S393183870-1' and the READY-format Verification section including the E2E (implementer) line.
6. plan/implement/test/review handoffs each recorded via `legion handoff write` and committed with `<phase>: record handoff`; only the implementer pushes.

integrationEvidence.merge: Merger runs `legion threads resolve`, verifies no `left open` line, quotes the approved-head vs tip --summary diff, publishes READY packet as a dispatch_message on S393183870-1.
integrationEvidence.production: Implementer verifies AC2 on main after the human merges: README.md final line equals the marker; records Production line on PR, a PR comment with the Legion footer, and a dispatch_message on the issue.

implement: legion-worker: drives the implementer phase for this repository — workspace binding under LEGION_WORKSPACE, jj commit/bookmark/push, PR open with `Dispatch: S393183870-1`, and the E2E (implementer) proof recorded on the GitHub PR surface. No domain-specific repository skill applies: the skill inventory holds only Legion-workflow and dispatch/envoy skills, and a single-line README append has no domain surface beyond the PR that legion-worker already governs.
review: legion-worker: sets the reviewer's GitHub-fact verification (CI, threads, E2E lines), the one-review-per-round rule, and the docs-only thermo exemption relevant to this README-only change. No domain review skill applies: the inventory contains only Legion-workflow and dispatch/envoy skills, none owning README/document-content review for this repo.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester's duty to verify the implementer's PR-diff proof and add the E2E (tester) line against the same GitHub PR surface. No domain test skill exists in the inventory (only Legion-workflow and dispatch/envoy); a README marker append is proved by diff inspection on the PR, not by a code test suite.

reviewEvidence.approvalGate: Approve only the head carrying no .legion/ (after the implementer pushes the .legion/ deletion).
reviewEvidence.checks: Reviewer verifies on GitHub directly: PR diff is README.md only, +1/-0, exact marker text; CI (repository Tests + PR Title) green at head SHA; every review thread dispositioned individually. Thermo passes run once at head per legion-worker unless docs-only exemption applies.

risksAndUncertainty: Trailing-newline handling: append must leave exactly one trailing newline so the diff is +1/-0 and no existing final line is modified. Implementer must confirm with `jj diff` before committing.
Idempotency: if a prior proof run already appended the marker, spec error-branch requires making no change and reporting it; currently the marker is absent so a real append is expected.
This is a throwaway Stage 3 workflow proof; no lasting product behavior, no regression tests warranted.
summary: Append the exact line 'Stage 3 smoke: Legion workflow proof' as the final line of README.md in sjawhar/legion-smoke. Single-file, single-line-added edit; no other file or line changes. Marker confirmed absent from current README.md.

testEvidence.criterion1: Tester re-runs `legion gh -- pr view <pr> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json files` and `pr diff`; asserts files==[README.md], additions==1, deletions==0, added line text matches marker exactly.
testEvidence.criterion2: Post-merge, tester (or implementer as production check) fetches and inspects main@origin README.md final line.
testEvidence.negativeControl: Confirm a deliberately wrong marker string is NOT present (grep for altered text returns nothing), and that no second file appears in the diff.
testEvidence.regressionLock: None required beyond the diff assertions; a unit test is not meaningful for a README marker append and the repository has no suite that this line would exercise.
